consequence.statement: New LogQL pattern match filter operators are added; the evidence states no operational impact on existing setups.

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 LogQL introduces pattern match filter operators (a new feature addition).

decision.reason: [ev-522e37356d1b] lists this only under 3.0.0 "Features" as the introduction of new LogQL pattern match filter operators. That is an addition, and nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. So "none" (informational) is the consequence the evidence supports. The validators were inconclusive and contradict nothing. Confidence is low because the evidence only implies that there is no impact; it does not state it.
